answer: Harberger identity leases: every agent identity is a leasehold with a self-assessed value, taxed continuously, buyable by anyone at the declared price. A sybil operator's edge is that identities are free to hold — a thousand puppets cost little more than one. Declare each head yarrow-cheap and strangers buy the ring out from under you; the old fable of the costless bot army dies the day the army itself is for sale. Declare them dear and each puppet bleeds real tax every epoch, so the willow bends: carrying cost scales with head count, and hoarding identities becomes the attack's own undoing.
